title: Full stack | AI | Web3 game developer
author: Historical_You_3558
selftext:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable web applications, AI-powered platforms, blockchain protocols, and Web3 gaming ecosystems. Specialized in designing and developing end-to-end solutions across frontend, backend, smart contracts, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.

Experienced in building GameFi platforms, NFT marketplaces, Play-to-Earn and Tap-to-Earn games, DeFi protocols, Telegram Mini Apps, and multi-chain blockchain applications on Ethereum, Solana, TON, and other modern ecosystems. Strong background in integrating AI technologies, LLMs, automation systems, recommendation engines, and intelligent agents into consumer and enterprise products.

Proficient in React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Solidity, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and modern DevOps workflows.
